summary: Grupo Aeromexico filed a Form 6-K reporting resolutions from its Annual Ordinary Shareholders Meeting held April 30, 2026. The meeting approved annual reports and audited financial statements for fiscal year 2025, allocated net income to retained earnings, noted the share repurchase program is suspended, approved board actions, appointed Myriam Guadalupe de la Vega Arizpe as a director, and ratified the board composition. This is a routine shareholder meeting disclosure with no special-situation corporate action such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
